meta.title: Vendor fills a dropdown column "Make": leave it unselected when it is required
gaps: The catalog cannot explicitly assert that the Make dropdown remains unselected or that it is required before submission.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot explicitly assert that the Make dropdown remains unselected or that it is required before submission.

plan.title: Required Make dropdown blocks vendor bid

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live RFQ with bids still open.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the RFQ pricing sheet in the vendor portal.
Confirm the buyer-added Make column is present on the vendor's bid sheet.
Enter the quote price without selecting Make and submit; the attempt must be refused or remain disabled.
